title: The map replacements: res/field/map_replacements/replacements.json
description: The chunks and matrices that the season, the version or an event replace when the field loads a matrix (archive a/0/1/0, read by src/ov012/map_replace.c and MapMatrix_Patch in src/ov012/map_matrix.c), in the archive's order. tools/data/map_replace_data.py packs them.

replacements.description: The entries, in the archive's order

matrix.description: The matrix it changes, a MAP_MATRIX_* constant

kind.description: chunk: the value is a map model that takes the first value's place in the matrix; matrix: the value is a matrix loaded in place of the first value's

anyOf.description: season: spring, summer, autumn, winter; version: Black (2), White (2); version_season: Black (2), then White (2) in each season
An event of EVENT_MAP_REPLACE_TABLE (src/ov012/map_replace.c) by its condition: before it, after it

values.description: One value for each case of the condition, the first the original: map models (MAP_MODEL_*) for a chunk, matrices (MAP_MATRIX_*) for a matrix
